turns.text: I choose Mage.
I pick Arcane Bolt and Arcane Ward.
I walk along the road toward the city gate of Alderwatch.
"Coming in," I say, and walk through the gate into the city.
I head uphill to the Guild hall and look for a reception desk or notice board.
I go to the middle window. "Good morning. I'd like to register with the Guild, and hear what work is available for a new mage."
"I'm paying," I say, and count out two silver.
I go through the ajar door to the members' board and look over the catacomb culling postings.

I take the tallow delivery slip and the catacomb clearing slip, and bring both back to the clerk. "I'd like to take these two — they're both at the ruined chapel, so I can do the delivery and the clearing in one trip."
"Off to Bram's," I say, and head out to find the chandlery on Low Street.
"I'll take the handcart," I say, and hand over the two copper deposit.
I take the cart's shafts and start hauling west toward the gate, watching for the low, wet stretch Bram warned about.
I wheel the cart around to the back of the hut, following the sound of the axe. "Keeper Odo? Tallow delivery from Bram's."
"No message from Bram. Delivery's done — who do I tell it's complete, or will the Guild clerk hear it from you?"
I stack the crates back onto the handcart. "I'll carry them down for you — second door on the left, you said? Show me the way."
I haul the crates down three at a time and stack them on the shelves, corners inward, as Odo directs.
I accept the water and bread, and ask Odo how the delivery slip gets marked done — mine still shows the contract active, so do I turn it in at the Guild clerk myself?
I thank Odo for the bread and head back along the road toward Alderwatch to turn in the delivery slip with the Guild clerk, glancing back to see whether Guard B signals anything from the stair-top.
I scan the new slips on the board for a Novice-level job suited to a lone mage.
I take the escort slip to the counter. "The cart escort to Reedford — mark that one taken for me. Where's the dyers' yard by the east gate, and is the route safe by day?"
I leave the Guild and find the dyers' yard by the east gate to introduce myself to Mistress Odell before tomorrow's muster, then look for a cheap room for the night nearby.
I take the boot of small beer by the fire and ask the carters whether any of them have run the Reedford road lately, and what the waylayers at the ford are like.
I finish the beer and turn in for the night, sleeping until first light so I'm at the dyers' yard shed in time for the muster with Tam.
I take the roll and sausage, hand over the copper, and head to the dyers' yard shed for the first-light muster with Tam.
I climb onto the bench, left side, with my staff across my knees. "Understood — get down, hold, and quiet on the road. Ready when you are, Tam."
I cast Arcane Bolt at Bandit B.
